Bharti Airtel Introduces Rs 279 Prepaid Data Voucher Featuring OTT Benefits

Overview of Airtel's Rs 279 Data Voucher

Bharti Airtel offers a prepaid data voucher priced at Rs 279 across all telecom circles. According to published reports, this offering functions strictly as a data add-on and does not include service validity. Users wishing to utilize this voucher must maintain an active base service validity plan on their mobile numbers.

The Rs 279 option stands out as the second most expensive data voucher offered by the operator, sitting just below the company's highest-priced data plan, which costs Rs 361.

Plan Benefits and FUP Limits

  • Data Allowance: The voucher provides a total of 30GB of Fair Usage Policy (FUP) data.
  • Voucher Validity: The data and associated benefits carry a one-month validity period, distinct from service validity.
  • Expiration: Any unused data expires concurrently with the voucher's validity.

Bundled OTT Subscriptions

Unlike standard high-data vouchers, the Rs 279 tier incorporates over-the-top (OTT) entertainment benefits. Reported inclusions for a one-month duration consist of:

  • Airtel Xstream Play
  • Netflix
  • JioHotstar
  • ZEE5

Industry observers note that this inclusion makes it one of the select prepaid options from the operator to bundle a Netflix subscription.

Practical Implications and Alternatives

Publishers calculate the average daily cost of the voucher at approximately Rs 9.3. The plan targets consumers seeking temporary data top-ups alongside specific streaming access.

For subscribers seeking alternative packages, lower-priced options exist, such as a Rs 200 plan that omits Netflix in favor of Amazon Prime Video.

How to Verify

Customers interested in confirming the availability, specific terms, or activation process of the Rs 279 data voucher are advised to check official Airtel channels, including the Airtel Thanks mobile application or the official company website, before making a purchase.
